mentions.name: bbbb
mentions.description: A minimal build backend for Python packages inspired by Flit that also supports projects with non-Python code and doesn't enforce distributions with a single top-level import package. Its core package (treated as the default) can only build wheels, while a separately declared dev package builds sdists and can be declared as an in-tree backend in pyproject.toml, so pure-Python projects can distribute sdists needing no build-time dependencies. The goal is to minimize download footprint and maximize modularity when end users turn an sdist into a wheel. Non-Python compilation, sdist content/metadata customization, and manifest filtering hook into arbitrary Python code with a simpler, narrower API than setup.py, meant to be extended with separately listed build-time support libraries.
mentions.problem: Existing build backends are heavier and more restrictive, and distributing sdists for pure-Python code currently forces build-time dependencies on end users who just want to build a wheel.
